summary: The lower-label support forces h_1 and h_2 to have opposite weak signs throughout the interior. The positive singleton-cell areas then provide strict-sign points on both sides, which forces the two zero lines to coincide and h_2=-alpha h_1 for alpha>0. Since h_3=c+(alpha-1)h_1 with c>2, requiring h_3<0 at singleton points on both opposite sides forces simultaneously alpha<1 and alpha>1. The contradiction is valid, all null-set and interior-point steps are justified, and the final universal inequality follows vacuously because the full realization set is empty.
